name: Armor
description: Magical armor — chain mail +1, plate of resistance, leather of stealth. Worn in the body slot.

name: Potion
description: A liquid consumed as an action. Includes potions of healing, oils of slipperiness, philtres of love.

name: Ring
description: Worn on a finger. A creature can normally wear two magic rings. Includes rings of protection, free action, regeneration.

name: Rod
description: Heavier than a wand and often serving as scepters. Activate with words or gestures — rods of lordly might, rule, security.

name: Scroll
description: A spell preserved on parchment. Spell scrolls are consumed on use; protection scrolls grant temporary resistance.

name: Staff
description: A long staff that can act as a quarterstaff and cast specific spells (often consuming charges). Staffs of power, healing, fire.

name: Wand
description: Slender device that holds a small number of charges to cast a specific spell — wand of magic missiles, wand of fireballs.

name: Weapon
description: A weapon enhanced with magical properties — flame tongue, vorpal sword, sun blade, longsword +1.

name: Wondrous Item
description: Catch-all category for magical accessories: capes, brooches, gloves, bags, cloaks, eyes, amulets, mirrors.
